geometry_audit: Seven meshes: nondegenerate triangles, normalized normals, x within +/-8m and y within +/-6m; no collider added.
changes: Added original chamfered wet-slate feeder lintel, jambs and protruding lip below ceiling.
Added shallow receiving basin front and side rims plus rippled dark water surface.
Lowered and advanced curled water shoulder to expose source and clear the ceiling.
Reduced fine repetitive streaking and differentiated five main flows.
Raised and broadened low mist over receiving water.
observations: heart_chamber_crystal and motion frames show a rolled source edge against visible dark stone below the ceiling.
Receiving rim is visible as a continuous dark segmented edge beneath the splash; the effect no longer terminates directly on the room cobbles.
Broad flows have irregular gaps and change texture across motion samples.
intake_gallery, pump_hall and sluice_crossing show source/basin silhouettes at the destination, but crystal remains dominant.
heart_chamber_banner contains no waterfall; existing banner/wall presentation unchanged.

independent_review: A fresh reviewer must issue the scoped waterfall verdict and Bars A/B; author does not self-accept.
type: Author implementation inspection; not independent visual acceptance

Crystal and existing cubes obscure much of central receiving area.

Existing sparse box room, banner and cyan sluice pools are outside this change.
